blind_alternative: leaves sizing entirely to the existing per-provider `file_upload_limit_check` implementations and adds no shared ceiling, no `size_mb` field and no sizing exception type
no aggregate ceiling at all — per-attachment limits only — or, if one is added, an incremental check that raises at the crossing attachment and reports the partial sum
no `size_mb` field exists on the block at all, so a url block is indistinguishable from an unmeasured base64 one; or remote URLs are rejected outright as unmeasurable
no count limit whatsoever — a prompt of forty tiny images is under every megabyte ceiling and is sent
prices a document block at the image rate `_OPENAI_TOKENS_PER_IMAGE["low"]` (85), or at the anthropic 2048 already in the tree
no fingerprint field at all; the block is the six ticket fields and nothing downstream asks for an id
uses the basename exactly as `os.path.basename` returns it, uncapped
with no fingerprint concept, url blocks carry nothing; the nearest wrong choice once added is hashing the decoded bytes and leaving url blocks `None`
passes `data.detail` straight through to the rendered block, so `"HIGH"` and `"ultra"` reach the provider verbatim
